content.short: BlockAI (BAI) combines blockchain and AI to offer accessible AI tools with no registration or fees.
content.description: BlockAI (BAI) merges blockchain with AI, delivering services such as text generation, image creation, and video summarization via BAI tokens. The platform includes AI agents like ChatGPT and DALL-E and is designed to operate across blockchains with multichain functionality. Smart contracts can autonomously request and receive AI task results, enabling smarter, more capable decentralized applications. Guided by a DAO, BlockAI emphasizes community-driven development, shaping services and features based on ongoing user feedback.
